The '''Lucaya Cross''' was a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] located in the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]]. It intersected the [[Shaltin Tunnels/Legends|Shaltin Tunnels]] hyperroute at [[Ession]], with endpoints at [[Media (planet)|Media]] and [[Saffalore]].<ref name="TEA" />
